steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Sir, I've searched the woodlands around the perimeter of the Paleroche clan and found no signs of mobilization.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Keep looking.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Gnosis, we've got an issue.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Gulo split from the Doctor's forces and led a team around Mount Karlan, breaking through the pass and occupying the station there!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Right now, Gulo is driving everyone out of the station, and another team is heading for Klin.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: That's where Yucatan is being held... Is this a rescue operation?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Impossible. They're being far too inefficient for that. There must be another motive.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Monch, based on the route you saw them taking, where do you think the Doctor is headed?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: ...They chose a route that could lead either to Mount Karlan or to the pass.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Oh... Could the Doctor intend to bypass Mount Karlan to directly attack our territory?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I should've warned you about this possibility.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: No, I was caught off guard myself. I should've stationed more troops at the pass.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The Doctor...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But, Arctosz still hasn't shown himself, and we cannot say for sure what their true objective is...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Grr, I'll have Valais head to the station to deal with Gulo, then Weiss will go to Klin.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Have a portion of the troops stationed at the base of the mountain go defend the pass and prevent the Doctor's forces from breaking through to our territory.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: General, we've already taken control of the station. Why are we still waiting here?

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: The Doctor told us to avoid hurting anyone, but I didn't hear anything about not smashing the place up. This station is a symbol of Silverash treachery.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Calm down. We'll see when the next train arrives––

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Grr... When's the thing supposed to arrive anyway? Let me see the note the Doctor left me...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Okay, that sounds about right.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant A
steps.text: Huh?! What's going on here?!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: This station now belongs to Gulo of the Paleroche clan! Get out of here, if you value your life!

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant B
steps.text: Why is the Paleroche clan here?!

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant A
steps.text: And it's none other than the terrible Gulo! Did the Paleroches declare war?!

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant B
steps.text: Ugh... I'm too young to die! Run!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: That's right! Run, faster!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Umm... General Gulo, thanks for bringing me along.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Hmph. I would want nothing to do with a Silverash daughter, if not for the fact that the Doctor told me you were helping.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: You really aren't in cahoots with that brother of yours?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'm here to stop him.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: ...I don't trust you, but I do trust the Doctor. The one called Sharp told me to trust in the victory the Doctor would bring.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Alright. Didn't you say you had to make your way up the mountain? Off with you.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: After you go, I'll have to halt the railroad... to do what again? Oh, right, gotta stop things from running so that Silverash reinforcements don't show up too quickly.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Well, thanks anyway, General Gulo!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: These people make no sense to me at all.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Whatever. I have my own things to do anyway.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph, that musclehead might not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but he certainly does know how to fight.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: He should be fine holding down the station.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Next up is... Dammit, my ass..

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior A
steps.text: Madame, why don't you get off the burdenbeast and rest for a bit? The rest of us can handle things.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph. I don't have the luxury for that right now.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Our task is much more difficult than Gulo's.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: In addition to rescuing Yucatan, we also have to take as much of Klin as we can.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Until the Doctor wins over on the other end, we have to draw the Silverashes' attention.

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior A
steps.text: Madame, can we really hold out against those numbers with the forces we have here? Are you sure this Doctor isn't just using us as fodder?

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior B
steps.text: That's right, the Matriarch...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Shut it.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Listen, Ratatos is sick and tired of carrying this clan on her back, so she's trusting this to me.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: We're at a do or die moment for the house of Browntail. If we succeed, the Browntail clan might just have a future. If we fail, we're all changing our names to Silverash.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I don't care what Enciodes is trying to do or what he wants Kjerag to be, but us Browntails will never be anyone's fodder.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If you're that eager to get a new name, then you can leave now. But if being a Browntail means anything to you, then come with me!

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior A
steps.text: (I've never seen Sciurus so charismatic before...)

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior B
steps.text: (I didn't know Sciurus had such a talent for speeches...)

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior C
steps.text: (I think she really is speaking her mind. She's just never been given a chance before.)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What are you mumbling about over there?!

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior A
steps.text: (Even though I heard that the Matriarch herself was planning on surrendering, if Sciurus isn't willing to give up, then...)

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior B
steps.text: (It would be really shameful for us to raise the white flag.)

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior C
steps.text: (That's right. And to be honest, I find it hard to believe that the Matriarch would do something like that...)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You're still not done? If you don't like it here, then beat it!

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warriors
steps.text: We fight for the house of Browntail!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph, that's more like it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Alright, I'll handle the rest.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Are you serious about this?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Don't worry. I'm a bona-fide pro.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: You'd better not die on us.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: I'll be waiting for the good news.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: As much as I've trained, it's been a long time since I've done any real mountaineering. Not since I came to Rhodes Island for treatment.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: This sure is getting my blood pumping, haha...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Wait for me, sis. I'm coming for you.
Ensia remembers how when she was a child, she always loved bringing her sister along to her climbs.
Though she was physically fit, she'd always give up halfway through.
Her favorite thing to do was to curl up on the sofa by the fire, knitting something for herself or her brother, or just napping.
'My sister probably doesn't like the mountains.' That's what Ensia thought.
But in the end, after becoming the Saintess, she was bound atop the mountain.
Ensia always had a dream – that one day, she would save her sister from the mountain.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: General, this railway should be useless now, right?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: No clue. But it probably isn't gonna work anymore.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But who gives a shit. The other job the Doctor gave us was to start some chaos in Silverash territory, the bigger the better.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Since we've already messed this place up pretty good, let's go somewhere else––

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: You sure took your sweet time, Valais.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Gulo, what exactly is the Doctor after?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: The sentimental side of me actually wants to tell you.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But, honestly, I got no clue what the Doctor is trying to do either, hahaha!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But what I do know is, I'm here to make enough trouble to give Enciodes a tough time!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Gulo, I'd prefer not to humiliate you.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Or any of the excellent warriors of the Paleroche clan.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: So lay down your arms. You have no chance of winning.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Valais, I know you've got some bad blood, and I'm not good at comforting people.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: I also know that there's nothing I can do to bring back what you've lost.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But I'm happy to rumble with you. Let you blow off your steam.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Phew... That should be it for the first checkpoint.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Ah... If I remember right, this trail was part of the trial to become a Saintess.
Ensia remembers, the night before the selection of the Saintess, her sister had some kind of fight with her brother.
That night, she sat alone on the sofa in the living room until the sun came up.
She still remembered telling her sister that if not for the fact that she was too young, she would've joined the Saintess selection process herself. Her sister smacked her upside the head.
Her sister was quite strong.
But never did she expect that this would be the last time her sister would smack her around.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Officer
steps.text: Sir, it's starting to snow.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: A good opportunity.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Kjeragandr smiles upon us, by the look of things.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Officer
steps.text: Though it took a lot of extra time to make our way to the Holy Hunt, it was well worth it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: How's the situation at the foot of the mountain?

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Officer
steps.text: It seems like the Doctor was able to divert their attention. The forces stationed there were far fewer than we expected.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Haha, good! Very good! The Doctor is quite capable!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Still, we can't afford to bring shame to the Paleroche name.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Warriors, now that our time is nigh, we need no longer conceal ourselves.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Forget the Silverashes! Follow me – we'll rush up the mountain and rescue the Saintess!

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warriors
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Why'd it have to start snowing now...?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Old Kjeragandr really has a dry sense of humor.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Or, maybe this is a test for me, as the sister of the Saintess?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Well, whatever.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: A bit of wind and snow can't hold me back!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: You can do this, Ensia! You weren't just talking big in front of Aurora! You've got this!
It was hard to send letters back to Kjerag from Rhodes Island.
Usually, she would only get the opportunity when Courier showed up.
Each time he visited, she always felt conflicted.
Fortunately, Courier would bring a letter from her sister.
Unfortunately, Courier and Matterhorn would always treat her like a kid, as if she couldn't see the sadness on their faces.
She is also a child of the Silverash family. She read the books left behind by her parents and knew of the vision they had for Kjerag. She also got good grades in Hypatia's class!
Of course she knew.
What she did not know is... Did things have to turn out like this?
If so, then why her family?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Sir, troops led by Arctosz suddenly appeared at the foot of the mountain and broke through the defensive line!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Grr... Where'd they come from?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I'm afraid they entered the site of the Holy Hunt, so our men were unable to track them down...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: And our forces stationed there couldn't stop them?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: A portion of the forces were split off to defend the pass, plus it suddenly started snowing, and morale was low to begin with. Since their goal was to break through the line...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You've been outplayed, Gnosis.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You made the right call. They care only about Mount Karlan and the Saintess. Everything else is secondary to that.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Did you come back only to mock me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No, I would've hesitated too, in your position.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just as you used your longstanding reputation within Karlan Trade to put on a play of half-truths...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Our lack of familiarity with the Doctor worked to that one's advantage – no shortage of tricks up those mysterious sleeves.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You may believe that the Doctor has designs on Kjerag, but from my perspective, I don't necessarily think that the Saintess is the only objective.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Of course, the Doctor could not be sure that we would see things this way, and that was the wager.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That you'd see the Doctor's actions around the pass as a move against Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Doctor only required that you be sufficiently concerned about this possibility to send your troops to assuage those concerns.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As such, the Doctor won the bet.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes, your arrogance is truly loathsome. To wax admiringly about the actions of your enemy at a time like this.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This is not a game, and we cannot afford to fail.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am not a fan of failure, Gnosis.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I've already sent Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: To intercept Arctosz?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No... Why do you think the Doctor chose a route that could lead either to Mount Karlan or the pass?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're saying that Arctosz's forces are a ruse.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: From the very beginning, the Doctor's forces were both the bait and the main force.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: No wonder why they were moving so slowly. They were waiting.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's right. And, if I'm not mistaken, this is when they will start making their move.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If the Doctor is allowed to group with Arctosz, then there would be real trouble.
Ensia already knows.
She knows her wish cannot come true.
She cannot save her sister from the mountain.
She also cannot mend the relationship between her two siblings.
How could she have no idea as to what her brother seeks to accomplish?
How could she not see that the rift between the two was only growing wider and wider?
But what can she do?
She doesn't like to cry, to vent her frustrations to others, or to give up.
All she can do is wedge the climbing pick in her hand into the rock above her head, and momentarily forget some of her troubles as she overlooks the scenery from atop the mountain.
Drifting snow strikes her face, leaving traces that look like streaks of tears.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: Doctor, Master Arctosz has begun to move.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: We've also heard that the Silverashes are reinforcing the pass.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: So far, everything is proceeding as you have planned.

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: So she's here.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: This is as far as you go, Rhodes Islander.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I remember your codename. You're Sharp.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Lucky the Doctor brought some spare clothes.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So that's what's going on. This entire army is both the genuine article and also a decoy.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: To be precise, this plan was specially tailored to you.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The Doctor had to plan for a contingency that included a woman strong enough to tear any plan to shreds.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I am not Enciodes. The admiration and respect of my enemies mean nothing to me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The only thing I need of my enemies is for them to be strewn across the ground.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Then you're in luck. You've got a whole army of opponents right in front of you.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You're the only one in this crowd worthy of being my opponent.
Degenbrecher shakes her head, sighing as if offering an immutable truth within her opinion.
Sharp looks at the woman before him, and for some reason, is reminded of his friend Stormeye, a fellow elite operator.
Stormeye would've been very happy to face an opponent like her.
But to him, whether mingling with the army here, or dealing with Degenbrecher, all of this is just a part of the job.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: It's a shame, an enemy's respect doesn't do much for me either.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I dislike glory, but you don't seem to care about it at all.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Nothing personal. It's just business.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Just business?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Doing business requires professionalism. Only an amateur would bring personal feelings to the job.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: There's nothing worth bragging about when it comes to my combat abilities. It's just one of my tools to get the job done.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hahaha, I like the way you think.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I've always despised self-righteous challengers, pumped up on their skills or ideals.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: And, without exception, I crushed them all underfoot.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I have heard of your feats as The Black Knight.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: A Leithanian who cannot use Arts, rendering all dignity and pride worthless before your greatsword.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Where is that greatsword, by the way?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Waving something like that around in this unsophisticated place would only scare the natives, so I decided to switch weapons.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Not that it matters what I use, though.
Degenbrecher flourishes the blade in her hand, and in the blink of an eye, the wind and snow itself seem to cleave in two.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: As for me, I was promised victory.
Sharp bends forward slightly, placing his hand on the hilt of the standard-issue knife at his waist.
Degenbrecher notices a familiar scent from him.
Back when she was in Kazimierz, only a few people gave off this same scent.
The scent of war.
